The proof policy distinguishes the actual residual object Sel_2(E_t)/<P1,...,P17> from BNF-free Kummer signatures, norm-one elements, S-class envelopes and incomplete local tests. A dimension at least 15 does not prove rank 32, and an incomplete or conditional computation is scheduling information rather than an exclusion. Production point searches have a separate gate requiring an exact fibre/model binding, finite resource limits, checkpoints and exact point certification; they do not require descent completion when no certified upper bound excludes the target. Fifteen independently certified quotient directions prove rank at least 32 regardless of descent state, while exact rank still requires a matching unconditional upper bound. EC-K3-ELKIES-2026-R28-BAD-PLACE-KUMMER proves the complete 2-division-discriminant factorization and every bad-place image of the known generic points, but explicitly supplies no ambient Selmer upper bound. A factor-supplied PARI backend then removed the hidden discriminant-factorization cost and entered the complete descent immediately with all 28 certified public points, effort zero, and no point search; strict 600-second and 1800-second runs with an 8 GB PARI stack still returned no Selmer dimension, at peak observed RSS 5698514944 and 6040723456. It records both the residual dimension modulo the generic 17 and the equivalent unexplained dimension beyond the known rank 28, rejecting below 15 or equivalently below four. Only a passing job calls TwoDescent, with all 28 certified points removed, so it materializes only genuinely unexplained covers; it contains no point search. Magma is absent on the current host, so this is an implemented external path, not a completed Selmer result. These timeouts and backend unavailability are implementation boundaries, not rank upper bounds, and do not decide the independent production search-budget gate.
